sloka: स समर्थो महाप्राज्ञस्तव युद्धविशारदः ।द्वन्द्वयुद्धं महद्दातुं नमुचेरिव वासवः ॥४-११-२२॥।।
transliteration: sa samartho mahāprājñastava yuddhaviśāradaḥ ।dvandvayuddhaṁ mahaddātuṁ namuceriva vāsavaḥ ॥4-11-22॥।।

translations.english: 'Vali is profoundly wise, an expert in warfare. He is capable of challenging you to a duel like Indra to Namuchi.
